changesApplied.changeMade: Added validatePath() function with path canonicalization and working directory restriction. Applied to read, write, edit, list handlers.
changesApplied.reason: Prevents path traversal attacks (../../etc/passwd, arbitrary file access) by resolving paths to canonical form and checking if they escape the working directory boundary.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: LOW blast radius - Internal function, no API changes. Path traversal attempts now blocked with clear error messages. No breaking changes for valid requests.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added command whitelist (34 safe commands) and dangerous pattern blocking (5 patterns). Created validateBashCommand() function applied before Bun.spawn().
changesApplied.reason: Prevents command injection attacks (rm -rf /, fork bombs, arbitrary code execution) by whitelisting only safe commands and blocking known dangerous patterns.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: MEDIUM blast radius - Intentionally blocks non-whitelisted commands (security by design). Non-whitelisted commands will fail with helpful error message listing allowed commands.

changesApplied.changeMade: Created ValidationException class, validateRunActivityRequest(), and validateRequestSize() functions. Lightweight validation without external dependencies.
changesApplied.reason: Prevents crashes from malformed input, prototype pollution, and DoS attacks by validating request structure, field types, and sizes before processing.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: LOW blast radius - New utility file with no existing dependencies. Gracefully handles existing valid requests. Invalid requests now return 400 with structured error details.

changesApplied.changeMade: Integrated validation utilities: validateRequestSize (10MB limit) and validateRunActivityRequest (schema validation). Returns 400 for validation errors, 500 for server errors.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces input validation at the entry point, preventing invalid data propagation through the system. Provides clear, actionable error messages to clients.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: LOW blast radius - Better error handling, no behavior change for valid requests. Invalid requests that previously crashed now return structured error responses.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added SIGTERM/SIGINT signal handlers for graceful shutdown. Stops accepting new requests, waits 5 seconds for in-flight requests to complete, then exits cleanly.
changesApplied.reason: Prevents in-flight activity loss during pod termination and ensures clean shutdown in Kubernetes. Critical for production deployment reliability.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: LOW blast radius - Only affects shutdown behavior. Improves shutdown reliability without changing runtime behavior. Clean shutdown on Ctrl+C and Kubernetes pod termination.
